bibliographic.title: This Might Be Our Year
bibliographic.author: bittybee123
bibliographic.description:
This is a teeny tiny piece of micro-fiction made for the Neo-twiny jam , about being a sports fan in the summer off-season and the hope and promise of the brand new championship to come. It comes in at 497 words , so just below the word limit.

Thank you for checking out my little piece of reflection, and I wanna especially thank the magnificent Ether for all their help and encouragement while I was planning and submitting this. They are amazingly talented and if you wanna read some of their beautiful work you can find it here.

I hope this year is your year and you have many good years to come .
